plain: On the show of a podcast host named Jesse Michels, a researcher named Joe McMoneagle says that long ago some big object passed through our solar system, and its gravity rearranged the planets and stripped Mars of its atmosphere. He gives no source for the idea. If true, it would mean Mars was once a very different world, one the episode suggests could have held life.
